decisions.reason: The Black Edition got more website presence from 2023 to 2024, which suggests results at or above aspiration in the bathroom-design trend segment, and it costs little to keep because it is a finish variant of existing drains.

CeraFrame Liquid has kept a dedicated page in both years and fits the growing seamless-bathroom market, so with the firm having already pruned weaker launches (C, D, E), there is no shortfall that would trigger dropping it.

The pump-drain channel was only launched in 2024 and probably replaces the withdrawn pump solution C, so slack from the pruning lets management give it time before judging it against aspirations, though its early stage makes it somewhat riskier.
